searchText: I get an RLP error decoding all the test headers from the eip7702 tests, but the rest seems fine. Anything special about the header? Where ? All these are failing for me with the same decoding header error. This looks like pyspecs prague test. It is not in ethereum/tests where did you find it? Should be from this release: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/devnet-1%40v1.1.0 It includes the 7702 fixtures Prague tests are in development and indeed will require changes but at this point it might be invalid as the eips are changing Please use https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/releases/tag/devnet-1%40v1.1.0 let me know if you get the same issue Those are the ones i am having issues with, but only for 7702 fixtures. Okay thanks for highlighting this, I need to take a look, do you have any more info on the failures? Looking at the header fields, they seem to match with the rest of the tests, but in the block body, eip7702 test have transactions with a new transaction type, could this be causing the decoding issue for you?
